name: comp-463
title: Pagination Rows Per Page
description: A single footer row with a Rows per page dropdown, a 1–25 of 100 range in the middle, and first, back, next and last arrows at the right.
use: A table footer where people should choose page size and also jump to the ends.
avoid: When the row is narrow: label, select, range and four arrows stay on one line without wrapping.
a11y: The select is tied to its label and each arrow has a name; menu and hover transitions have no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On black, a small Rows per page label sits beside an outlined 25 selector at the left, a dim 1–25 of 100 range runs in the middle, and four tiny chevron arrows close the right end. The open menu lists 10, 25, 50 and 100 with a tick.
behaves: Opening the selector drops a short menu; choosing 50 updates the trigger to 50 while the range and arrows hold still. A tick stays on the current choice.
customise: currentPage and totalPages drive the arrows; the rows-per-page options and the visible 1–25 of 100 text are hardcoded, so real totals need edits.
weight: light: One small select and four arrow links; nothing runs in the background.
